functions.name: SetWheelRadius
functions.docs: Set the wheel radius - can change dynamically during simulation if desired

functions.name: SetAngularPosition
functions.docs: Set the angular position in radians

functions.name: SetAngularVelocity
functions.docs: Set the angular position in radians/sec

functions.name: SetMatchingSpeed
functions.signature: SetMatchingSpeed(Target, Linear Meters Per Second In)
functions.docs: set wheel rotational speed to match the specified linear forwards speed

functions.name: SetBrakeTorque
functions.signature: SetBrakeTorque(Target, Brake Torque In, Engine Braking In)
functions.docs: Set the braking torque - decelerating rotational force

functions.name: SetDriveTorque
functions.docs: Set the drive torque - accelerating rotational force

functions.name: SetBrakeTorqueOverride
functions.signature: SetBrakeTorqueOverride(Target, Brake Torque In, Engine Braking In)

functions.name: SetVehicleGroundSpeed
functions.docs: Set the vehicle's speed at the wheels location in local wheel coords

functions.name: SetWheelLoadForce
functions.docs: Set the force pressing the wheel into the terrain - from suspension

functions.name: SetSurfaceFriction
functions.docs: Set the friction coefficient of the surface under the wheel

functions.name: GetNormalisedFrictionFromSlipAngle
functions.docs: Amount of friction we can expect after taking into account the amount the wheel slips

functions.name: GetForceFromFriction
functions.docs: return the calculated available friction force

functions.name: GetEffectiveRadius
functions.docs: Get the radius of the wheel [cm]

functions.name: GetAngularPosition
functions.docs: Get the angular position of the wheel [radians]

functions.name: GetAngularVelocity
functions.docs: Get the angular velocity of the wheel [radians/sec]

functions.name: GetWheelRPM
functions.docs: Get the wheel RPM [revolutions per minute]

functions.name: InContact
functions.docs: Is the wheel in contact with the terrain or another object

functions.name: GetNormalizedLongitudinalSlip
functions.docs: Get the current longitudinal slip value [0 no slip - using static friction, 1 full slip - using dynamic friction]

functions.name: GetWheelLoadForce
functions.docs: Get the magnitude of the force pressing the wheel into the terrain

functions.name: GetSurfaceFriction
functions.docs: Get the friction coefficient of the surface in contact with the wheel

functions.name: GetSlipAngle
functions.docs: Get the slip angle for this wheel - angle between wheel forward axis and velocity vector [degrees]

functions.name: GetDriveTorque
functions.docs: Get the drive torque being applied to the wheel [N.m]

functions.name: GetBrakeTorque
functions.docs: Get the braking torque being applied to the wheel [N.m]

functions.name: GetRoadSpeed
functions.docs: Get the road speed at the wheel

functions.name: GetWheelGroundSpeed
functions.docs: Get the linear ground speed of the wheel based on its current rotational speed

functions.name: GetSlipMagnitude
functions.docs:
Get the difference between the wheel speed and the effective ground speed of the vehicle at the wheel
positive if wheel is faster than effective ground speed, negative if wheel is slower

functions.name: GetSkidMagnitude
functions.docs:
Get the effective ground speed along the lateral wheel axis
positive if wheel is faster than effective ground speed, negative if wheel is slower

functions.name: Simulate
functions.docs:
Simulate - figure out wheel lateral and longitudinal forces based on available friction at the wheel
Wheel load force from body weight and the surface friction together determine the grip available at the wheel
DriveTorque accelerates the wheel
BrakeTorque decelerates the wheel
